why: the options half of the same collapse. `rcl_init_options_t` is built, mutated (set_domain_id), copied and finalised before rcl_init consumes it; ours are not arguments at all: `rclc_support_init(&support, argc, argv, &allocator)` has rclc's signature since phase-492 W1.b, and the two values rcl's options would carry (locator, domain) come from the build and, on a hosted target, the environment (`NROS_LOCATOR`, `ROS_DOMAIN_ID`). `rclc_support_init_with_locator` takes them explicitly. There is no `nros_init_options_t`. CORRECTED 2026-09-04 (phase-417): the sweeping form of this claim -- "there is no runtime options object" -- is false one stage over.
